method: 2-yr stretch percentile = (close - EMA8) / ATR14 (Wilder), mid-rank inside the name's own trailing 504 sessions; names in v2/data/mrmap.json use its value, the rest are recomputed from local daily grouped bars; n/a under 250 sessions of its own history (bars before a hole longer than 30 days are never spliced in), when the last bar is not the as-of day, or when a CONFIRMED split sits in the last 80 sessions (MR MAP rule: integer-ratio move with normal dollar volume; applied to every name). A big one-day gap that is not a split (<= -45% or >= +80%) keeps its value and is flagged.
